verdict.rationale: Pulumi offers pre-deployment validation only indirectly. Fast in-memory unit tests in the program's own language can check resource definitions before any infrastructure is touched, and policy-as-code guardrails exist. Nothing in the evidence shows a dedicated validate command or any auto-formatting of configuration. Missing for 10: a documented validate step distinct from preview, any auto-format capability, and independent corroboration of a pre-plan validation workflow.
